verdict.rationale: Cross-device identity resolution is a fair question for a web analytics product, so the axis applies. The evidence shows Plausible deliberately avoids it: it collects no personal data and counts uniques with a daily-salted hash of IP and user agent, rather than storing data in a way that builds user profiles. No identify or alias call and no merging of anonymous pre-signup activity is documented.

support.subject: As a developer, I can identify users across devices and merge anonymous pre-signup activity into their identified profile
